textSegments: MIA IC (Multiple Intelligence Ability) chip set inside
Full protections OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
The DAGGER PRO series is compatible with most Mini-ITX and Micro ATX small form factor PCs. It is ideal for home computer rigs but a great alternative for mini-PC enthusiasts.
Advance Cable Management and Flat Ribbon Cables
Fully-modular design and flat ribbon cables provide easier installation. An ideal solution for applications with space constraints, enhancing overall airflow efficiency and cable management.
Dagger PRO is included an advanced semi-fanless design that will spin over 20% loading, make silent and reduce noise under maximum operation.

Dagger PRO series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and as a result to reduce lots of electricity cost.
Powerful +12V Single Rail for your VGA

VGA card is a component which needs greedy and stable power supporting most. The compact size DAGGER PRO series comes with a single +12V rail design that offers VGA cards full power individually and to avoid any overloading conditions.
For gaming enthusiast, the DAGGER PRO series features dual CPU power connectors to support high-end motherboards and provide stable power to the CPU for gaming.
Dagger PRO series uses Japanese electrolytic capacitors to ensure a longer lifetime and protect your PSU from sudden power change!
Adapts to your individual requirements, not only does it fit into cases with the SFX form factor, but can also be installed in a simple steps into normal ATX, Micro-ATX or Mini-ITX cases.

"FSP revamped its Dagger Pro line, and the flagship model with 850 W maximum power output fares well enough against the competition. It is one of the strongest SFX PSUs available on the market today, and it is impressive to see such high power output from such a compact platform."
